t: Forge Steel G-clamp is a heavy-duty 3-way clamping tool for securing materials in professional environments. Featuring a 60mm jaw opening and 63.5mm throat depth, it provides a firm grip for various applications, such as joinery or temporary component holding. The powder-coated, cast-iron frame ensures optimal strength, durability, and rust resistance for prolonged site or workshop use. Designed with a strong threaded steel spindle to allow precise adjustments and deliver a substantial maximum clamping force of up to 2646 kg/m², and a comfortable steel handle, making it a reliable choice for demanding trade tasks.
